neuroticism.behavioral_influence: High behavioral influence - prone to anxiety, fear, and dramatic reactions when vulnerable

racial_traits.fey_ancestry: You have Advantage on Resolution Checks against being Charmed, and magic can't put you to sleep.
racial_traits.darkvision: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You discern colors only in shades of gray.

urban_tracker.urban_discretion: You gain Proficiency in Sleight of Hand, providing Advantage on relevant Resolution Checks.
urban_tracker.urban_camouflage: When in an urban environment (city, town, large settlement), you can attempt to move stealthily at a normal pace without penalty for doing so. Additionally, you gain Advantage on Stealth (Coordination) checks to blend into crowds or urban environments.
urban_tracker.urban_hunter: When tracking Humanoids in an urban environment, you also learn their general profession, likely affiliations (if common knowledge), and how long ago they passed through the area (within reason, e.g., last 24 hours). You gain Advantage on Wisdom (Survival) or Intelligence (Investigation) checks made to track Humanoids in urban environments.
urban_tracker.description: You are an unparalleled tracker and survivor within civilized settlements. This replaces the standard 'Natural Explorer' feature.
urban_tracker.urban_navigation: You can't become lost in urban environments except by magical means. You always know the general direction of major landmarks and the quickest routes between districts.

spellcasting.description: You gain the ability to cast Ranger spells. Your spellcasting ability is Wisdom. You know two 1st-level spells from the Ranger spell list, and you have two 1st-level spell slots. You regain all spent spell slots on a Long Rest. Your Spell Save CN is 10 + your Combat Prowess Bonus (+2) + your Wisdom Modifier (+0) = 12.

favored_foe.hunter_insight: You gain Proficiency in Investigation, providing Advantage on relevant Resolution Checks.
favored_foe.ensnaring_advantage: Creatures you hit with Ensnaring Strike (either ranged or melee) have Disadvantage on their Saving Throw against its effects.
favored_foe.description: When you hit a creature with an attack roll, you can mark it as your Favored Foe for 1 minute or until you lose concentration (as if concentrating on a spell). The first time on each of your turns that you hit your favored foe (Humanoids) and deal damage to it, you can deal an additional 1d4 damage. You can use this ability a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus (which is +2 at Level 1, so 2 times).
